pages.title: Active Item Extraction
pages.text: The Output Port actively extracts items from adjacent containers or machines and pushes them onto connected belts.$(br2)Solves the problem of machines not auto-outputting to belts.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Place the Output Port against a container's output side, then connect a belt to its output direction. The port auto-extracts items and pushes them to the belt.$(br2)Works with: regular chests, machine output slots, Protocol Stashes, and other containers.
Check the exact recipe in the Crafter. Required materials can be looked up in REI/JEI.
